newsitem.title: HUNGARY: KOMERCNI RESULTS BOOST OTP - ANALYST.
newsitem.headline: KOMERCNI RESULTS BOOST OTP - ANALYST.

text.p: Shares in Hungary's largest commercial bank OTP Bank have surged by some seven percent in heavy trade on the Budapest bourse, benefiting from Czech bank Komercni Banka results, an analyst said.
Komercni and OTP are the only central European banks traded on the SEAQ in London.
"Komercni Banka published its figures today and they were very good," said Spencer Jakab, Budapest-based analyst at CS First Boston. "This certainly played a role (in OTP's rally.)"
OTP shares closed at the day's high of 4,000 forints, up 280 on the Budapest bourse, while on the SEAQ they stood at $22.64 at 1207 GMT, up from $21.005 at opening.
On the SEAQ Komercni's GDRs were quoted at $31.55 at 1058 GMT, after opening at $31.00, while they traded at 2,479 crowns at 1221 GMT, after opening at 2,453 in Prague.
Traders said foreigners were buying OTP shares intensively, some of them paying market price for them.
